Name: PIF - Sulphur Cave
Author: Winterdrop
Description:
After the [size=2]unexpected [/size]success of the Sulphur Farm [size=1](I'm so happy that it suits your OCs and runs ideas <3)[/size] [s]and despite me still not knowing how to do decent maps[/s], I was curious to see how a PIF Room could turn out with the same concept. Like this, I suppose.
It has no customizable walls or floor - it's a cave, after all - but you can still decorate it of course; it works like a greenhouse, so you can grow crops and trees. If life is being a little too tiresome, take a moment to relax into the thermal pond nearby!

═══════

[img]https://i.ibb.co/HTxrpPHG/features.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Glowing, animated lava and steam all over the room (like the farm)
[*]Can grow crops and trees; grass won't grow
[*]Small thermal pond surrounded by lava, perfect to relax
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/N67D7GgL/configs.png[/img]
[size=1](Either use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ or edit the config.json file in the mod folder)[/size]

[list]
[*][i]Disable Steam[/i]: Look, I get it that is hot in here... but not this much! [i]DEFAULT: False.[/i]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/6JpWHw0t/requirements.png[/img]
[b][size=3]▹ Mandatory[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27117]Sharogg's Tilesheets[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13804]Custom Farm Loader[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url]﻿ [size=1](for steam and light options)[/size]
[/list][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][size=3][b]▹ Optional/Suggested[/b][b]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28537]Door Mania[/url]﻿
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/JRZqgfvd/installation.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Install all the required mandatory mods first
[*]Download the mod and unzip it in StardewValley/Mods
[*]Run via SMAPI
[*]Purchase a Dimensional Door; place it anywhere, then select the Sulphur Cave for it.
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/n8bpPS5M/tba-maybe-maybe-not-idk.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*]Multi-upgrades to expand the cave
[*]Compatibility with other recolors
[*][size=1]Can you catch fish in the lava...?[/size]
[*]Moar translations!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/nM1f6TWj/credits-other.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Eternal kudos to all the modders making all of this possible, and the Stardew DIscord Community for the never-ending support!
